name: MexiPho
notes: Menu transcribed item by item from the restaurant's own website; prices and descriptions as printed. Address from website. Phone from website. Hours not listed online.

sections.name: Burritos
items: Mexican-style burrito in a 12" flour tortilla. Our recommendation for your build is with Spanish rice, pinto beans, protein choice, pico de gallo, crema fresca cheese, iceberg lettuce, your salsa level choice, and guac!

Build your own Vietnamese style. Our recommendation for your traditional way is a 12" flour tortilla with white pho rice noodles, pick your protein, cilantro, scallions, bean sprouts, white onions, Thai basil, fresh jalapenos, cheese, and our signature PHOrrito sauce

sections.name: Tacos
items: 3 tacos, protein choice. Our recommendation for your build is cilantro, onions, salsa level of your choice, and lime. Or served with rice and beans, meat choice, pico de gallo, lettuce, sour cream cheese, and salsa

sections.name: Bowls
items: Fried flour tortilla into a bowl. Our build recommendation is with romaine lettuce, rice, beans, protein choice, fajita veggies, pico de gallo, crema Fresca, fancy shredded cheese, salsa level of choice & guac
Burrito bowl to build your way!
Build your own way. Our choice is romaine lettuce, carrots, cucumber, spinach, pico, corn, mushrooms, cheese, and our house light dressing!

sections.name: PHO' Soups
items: The authentic Vietnamese soup with GF white rice noodles, protein choice, cilantro, scallions, white onions, fresh jalapenos, Thai basil, bean sprouts, fresh lime, and pick your broth. Hoisin and siracha sauce on the side

sections.name: Quesadillas
items: 12" flour tortilla with melted Tex-Mex fancy cheese and meat of choice. Our recommendation for your build is rice and beans of choice, fajita veggies, pico de gallo, and sour cream on the side

sections.name: Tortas
items: Build your own. Our recommendation is bolillo bread, toasted base, pinto beans, meat choice, pickled jalapenos, pico de gallo, iceberg lettuce, and crema fresca

sections.name: Nachos
items: Our recommendation for your build is homemade crispy corn tortilla chips, rice & beans, choice of meat, choice of fajita veggies, melted white queso, pico de gallo, pickled jalapeno, crema fresca, and iceberg lettuce

sections.name: Desserts
items: 5 churros about 4" each with caramel or chocolate dip on the side

sections.name: Soft Drinks
items: Honest Tea Half Tea Half Lemonade

sections.name: Margaritas
items: Lime flavored - top off with Patron tequila +4.99
